task.prompt:
# Spark Agent Demo Plan

Build a one file HTML calculator with a very nice and professional UI. I only want one file in the directory in the end. In this eval workspace, the plan file is named `spark-eval-plan.md`, so the final directory must contain exactly `spark-eval-plan.md` plus one self-contained `.html` file.

The calculator must work without a server or external assets. Put all HTML, CSS, and JavaScript in the one HTML file.
